I wanted my fund's return. What I got was total assets by fund type in millions of shekels, which is not what I asked for.

findings.what: The filter box doesn't visibly do anything: typing a fund company and pressing Enter changes nothing on screen
You have to move funds between two list boxes with tiny < > arrows, which is an old and confusing way to pick things
The default report shows industry totals in millions, not fund returns, so it doesn't answer the question in the link I clicked
The page looks like an old government form, and I'd swipe away on my phone in seconds
There are two different return numbers (13.65% and 10.56%) with no clear explanation of which to use
The fund-type names are jargon I don't know
The charts are small and dense, the bar labels overlap, and you can't read them
